description:
This project is a Design-Build contract to support the Space Development Agency (SDA) by constructing a Relay Ground Station-South (RGS-S) at Schriever Space Force Base. The purpose is to provide the necessary facilities and infrastructure to support the RGS-S mission within a restricted area.

The scope of work requires the contractor to design, procure, install, and commission a complete and usable facility. The primary components of the project include:

  • Concrete pads
  • Antenna pedestal foundations and radome ringwalls
  • Site utilities, pathways, and cabling
  • Backup generators and fuel tanks
  • Shelters
